criteria.description: Null variant in a gene where loss of function is a known disease mechanism.
caveats: Variant is a bona fide null (nonsense, frameshift, canonical \u00b11/2 splice, initiation codon, single/multi-exon deletion)
Loss of function is an established disease mechanism for this gene
Transcript is biologically and clinically relevant (e.g. MANE Select / clinical transcript)
NMD considered: variant not in the 3\u2032-most exon or last 50 bp of the penultimate exon (or NMD-escape assessed)
For splice / large deletion: reading frame and functional-domain impact assessed
No predicted rescue by alternative start or re-initiation
Strength graded per the ClinGen PVS1 decision tree where the null context is not full very-strong

criteria.description: Same amino-acid change as a previously established pathogenic variant, regardless of nucleotide change.
De novo (maternity and paternity confirmed) in a patient with the disease and no family history.
Well-established functional studies show a damaging effect.
Prevalence in affected individuals significantly increased over controls.
Located in a mutational hot spot or critical, well-established functional domain without benign variation.
Absent, or at extremely low frequency, in population databases.
caveats: Population database(s) named (e.g. gnomAD v4, 1000 Genomes)
Ancestry-specific frequencies reviewed, not only global frequency
Read coverage at the site is adequate in the database
Frequency threshold appropriate to disease prevalence and penetrance
Applied at Supporting strength per ClinGen SVI (note if Moderate retained)

criteria.description: For recessive disorders, detected in trans with a pathogenic variant.
Protein-length change from in-frame indels or stop-loss in a non-repeat region.
Novel missense change at a residue where a different pathogenic missense change was seen before.
Assumed de novo without confirmation of maternity and paternity.
Co-segregation with disease in multiple affected family members.
Missense in a gene with a low rate of benign missense and where missense is a common mechanism.
Computational evidence supports a deleterious effect (use one calibrated predictor at calibrated thresholds).
caveats: A single calibrated meta-predictor used (e.g. REVEL, BayesDel), not multiple correlated tools
Calibrated threshold matched to the applied strength (e.g. ClinGen SVI / Pejaver 2022)
Not double-counting with PM1, PM5 or PS1
Splice prediction (e.g. SpliceAI) treated separately

criteria.description: Patient phenotype or family history highly specific for a single-gene disease.
Reputable source reports pathogenic but evidence is unavailable.
Allele frequency above the disease-appropriate stand-alone benign threshold in a well-covered population.
caveats: Allele frequency exceeds the disease-appropriate stand-alone benign threshold in a well-covered population
Not a recognised low-penetrance or founder exception (ClinGen)
Filtering allele frequency (FAF) considered with adequate coverage

criteria.description: Allele frequency greater than expected for the disorder.
Observed in a healthy adult where full penetrance is expected at an early age.
Well-established functional studies show no damaging effect.
Lack of segregation in affected family members.
Missense in a gene where only truncating variants cause disease.
Observed in trans with a pathogenic variant in a fully penetrant dominant gene, or in cis with a pathogenic variant.
In-frame indel in a repetitive region without known function.
Computational evidence supports no impact (use one calibrated predictor at calibrated thresholds).
caveats: A single calibrated predictor used at the calibrated benign threshold
Not in conflict with splice prediction
Not double-counting with other computational criteria

criteria.description: Variant found in a case with an alternate molecular basis for disease.
Reputable source reports benign but evidence is unavailable.
Synonymous variant with no predicted splice impact and not highly conserved.
